units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:20">Ab. IV, 20</cite> <he>דיו כתובה על נ׳ חדש</he> ink on a new blank, opp. <he>נ׳ מחוק</he> palimpsest.
<cite ref="Gittin 9b:3">Gitt. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ חלק</he> blank paper, v. <cite ref="S02128"><he>קָרַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 19b:13">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>נתן לה נ׳ חלק</he> if he handed her a blank sheet.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:4">Kel. X, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 160:5">Sifré Deut. 160</cite> <he>לא על נ׳</he> not on a loose sheet, opp. <he>מגילה</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְיָירוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:16-19">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>סופרים … מדבקין בהו נְיָירוֹתֵיהֶן</he> scribes … glue their parchments with it (Ms. M. <he>נַיְירוֹתַיְיהוּ</he> ch. form).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:5">Kel. II, 5</cite> <he>כסוי … נ׳</he> (Var. <he>והנ׳</he>) covers … made of papyrus; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 5</cite> <he>ניארות</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>ונרות</he>, corr. acc.).
